d: The Aladdin Client Engagement (ACE) group manages strategic technology partnerships with Aladdin clients globally. ACE serves as the senior, trusted interface between clients and the Aladdin business, with accountability for value delivery, platform adoption, and long-term commercial outcomes.

This is a highly visible, client-facing role supporting Tier-1 Middle East institutions, including large asset owners and institutional investors. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to client stakeholders, build strong and durable relationships across business and functional teams, and develop a detailed understanding of each institution's priorities, challenges, and evolving needs. Through proactive engagement and consistent follow-through, they will help clients realize measurable value from Aladdin, eFront, and WPS across their Public and Private Markets investment lifecycles.

As part of one of BlackRock's fastest-growing businesses, you will join a team focused on helping institutional investors maximize value from their investment technology ecosystem. The team works closely with clients across investments, risk, operations, technology, and data functions, partnering with product, engineering, transformation, and commercial teams to deliver measurable outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with some of the most sophisticated asset owners and institutional investors in the Middle East while contributing to the growth of the Aladdin business.

You will help manage important elements of the front-to-back client relationship, building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders and ensuring client priorities are understood and acted upon across BlackRock. Through a combination of investment lifecycle knowledge, consultative problem solving, and disciplined execution, you will help drive adoption, value realization, and long-term relationship success. You will serve as a critical link between clients and internal teams, translating client objectives into actionable plans and coordinating execution across multiple stakeholders.

Build and maintain trusted client relationships, developing a deep understanding of client objectives, stakeholder dynamics, priorities, risks, and opportunities while ensuring strong relationship health and execution discipline.
Lead preparation for governance reviews and strategic engagements, using client insights to support platform adoption, renewals, and growth opportunities.

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
